_comment: Order of the home screen. The first 6 form the glass dock. Apps that are not installed are skipped. Other installed apps are added at the end. Copy this file to /sdcard/Android/data/app.glasshome.launcher/files/apps.json to override it. Add a free TMDB API key (themoviedb.org) as tmdb_api_key to show 'Featured on …' titles for Netflix, HBO Max, Disney+, Prime Video and Apple TV.
